results.note: Jerusalem Post reports consultations concluded on 5 Nov with Yashar, B'Yachad, Democrats, Yisrael Beytenu, Ra'am and Joint List recommending Eisenkot: 21+12+8+7+8+11=67 seats.
Herzog announced only that he would grant the mandate on Sunday (8 Nov) and would meet party heads over the weekend; he named no one by 23:59 on 6 Nov.
Herzog announced only a date (Sunday 8 Nov) for awarding the mandate, without stating he would task Eisenkot, within the window.

ČSÚ's 6 Nov release headline says industrial production rose 6.2% y/y in real terms in September, with y/y figures stated as working-day adjusted.
Cenový věstník 119/2026 of 6 Nov sets the maximum diesel price for 7-9 Nov 2026 at CZK 47.28 per litre incl. VAT, below 48.50.
ČSÚ's 6 Nov release reports a September 2026 goods trade surplus of CZK 23.7 bn in current prices.
Sejm vote 43 of the 68th sitting at 16:54 on 6 Nov: no-confidence motion against Kierwiński (druk 3279) got 212 yes, 235 no, short of 231.
Sejm vote 42 on 6 Nov adopted consent to extend the asylum restriction (druk 3276), 425 yes, 17 no, 1 abstention.
Sejm vote 73 on 6 Nov passed the 2027 budget special-solutions bill (druk 3154) as a whole, 236 yes, 187 no, 22 abstentions.
La Provence reports the TGV M left Paris Gare de Lyon on the morning of 6 Nov with SNCF chief Jean Castex and was inaugurated on arrival at Marseille Saint-Charles at about 13:05.
Ukrinform, relaying the Air Force's Telegram morning summary of 6 Nov (09:34 Kyiv), reports 227 attack and decoy drones launched from 18:00 on 5 Nov, above the 150 threshold.

Kyiv Independent's prisoner-exchange tag lists no swap after the 270-POW exchange of 23 Oct, and Interfax-Ukraine and Ukrinform feeds for 5-6 Nov show none; the Coordination HQ site refused scripted reading, so this rests on the absence of any report in those outlets.

The 5 Nov White House meeting statement only recounts the Oleshky ceasefire signed 23 Oct and the evacuation of about 800 people and calls for further cooperation, with no new agreed measure; Lubinets coverage (UNN, Ukrinform) says only that he and Melania Trump discussed returning civilians, and Interfax-Ukraine shows no new agreement.
The BLS Employment Situation release of 6 Nov 2026 says total nonfarm payroll employment rose by 165,000 in October.
The BLS release of 6 Nov 2026 shows payrolls up 165,000 in October, not below zero.
The BLS release of 6 Nov 2026 puts the October unemployment rate at 4.1 percent, below 4.3.
The Daily of 6 Nov 2026 says employment was little changed in October (-4,700; 0.0%), seasonally adjusted.

On 6 Nov the Eurogroup President issued a 'Statement on the nominations for the post of ECB President' (consilium, 16:14 GMT) listing Spain's Hernández de Cos and the Netherlands' Knot as the nominees; ABC, El País and others reported that Spain formally submitted his candidacy (the consilium page refuses scripted reading, so the content comes from news-feed headlines).

When nominations closed on 6 Nov the Eurogroup named only two candidates, Knot (Netherlands) and Hernández de Cos (Spain); Bloomberg ('the only two candidates') and WSJ ('officially a two-horse race') confirm that no other government nominated anyone.

Al Jazeera's Tehran correspondent reports US projectiles hit Qeshm Island on Friday night (6 Nov) and that Trump called them 'minor strikes'. Xinhua reports Trump said on Friday that US forces had launched new strikes on Iran's air defences. Marked ambiguous because the exact strike time against the 23:59 Tehran cut-off is not given and comes from secondary outlets (CENTCOM page returned no content).

WLBT carries AP's count. Its report published 00:29 UTC 7 Nov (19:29 ET on 6 Nov) shows Colom 467,930 (49.1%) to Hyde-Smith 465,356 (48.8%) with 96.9% in and no call. WLBT's results box still shows those figures on 8 Nov, so Colom led at 23:59 ET on 6 Nov.
As of 6-7 Nov, WLBT (AP results) and its weekly recap say the race remains too close to call, with no winner marked. AP made no call in the window.

Xinhua on npc.gov.cn (Beijing, 6 Nov) reports that the closing meeting of the 14th NPC Standing Committee's 25th session on the morning of 6 Nov passed 5 laws, including the Anti-Cross-Border Corruption Law (反跨境腐败法). The NPC front page also carries the headline '反跨境腐败法表决通过'.

The same Xinhua report on the 6 Nov closing meeting of the 25th session says the session decided to ratify one agreement: the Agreement on the Establishment of the World Artificial Intelligence Cooperation Organization (审议批准关于成立世界人工智能合作组织的协定).

BusinessTech (22:20 SAST, 6 Nov, 95% counted nationally) and EWN (6 Nov, 82% of districts) both report the DA leading in Johannesburg, ahead of the ANC and ActionSA. Marked ambiguous because the IEC dashboard could not be read and Johannesburg's own capture percentage at 23:59 and its final declaration were not seen.

BusinessTech, citing results at 95% counted on the evening of 6 Nov, puts the ANC at 31.2% nationally. EWN gives about 31% at 82% of districts. Both are far below 35.0%. Taken from secondary outlets because the IEC dashboard did not render.

ukmto.org refused scripted reading (403); Arab News (12:24 UTC 6 Nov) reports UKMTO saying on Friday 6 Nov that a tanker suffered an explosion at its port-side waterline 16 nm east of Khasab in the Strait of Hormuz; the incident date is inferred as 6 Nov from the same-day report (the Velos Sapphire missile hit was Thursday 5 Nov and is not counted).
On 4 Nov Trump told reporters 'We'll stay out of it' on the House GOP leader race, and searches found no endorsement of a named candidate on 5-6 Nov; Truth Social could not be checked directly.

On 4 Nov PS said all opposition parties had signed the motion to remove Blanar and that signatures would be handed over 'in the coming days' (TASR/teraz.sk, info.sk, refresher.sk). No TASR, SME, Pravda, Aktuality or other outlet reports a submission on 5-6 Nov. On 8 Nov Sipos (Slovensko) spoke only of having 'added signatures' and called Blanar 'next in line'. The NRSR register was not readable (bot wall). Resolved under the 72-hour rule from the absence of any filing report.
